statements.text: Choose a useful AI task and say what a good result would look like.
Give AI a clear instruction and clarify it when the response misses my meaning.
Choose helpful background and leave out unnecessary or private details.
Check an AI result and decide what to use, change or reject.
Save useful context, find it again and adapt it for another task.
Choose my next practice goal and a small step to work on it.
